_comment: Lives in src/ (not demo/) because it's the authoritative containment/attribute grammar for the whole fx-* element set, not a demo-only artifact - it ships with the npm package via the 'src/**/*' files entry, unlike anything under demo/. Consumed by demo/fore-codemirror/src/fore-html-mode.js (the CodeMirror linter) via a relative import, and also read by the fore-skills companion repo when regenerating its element reference. Replaces fore-schema.json + fore-structure.json + fore-categories.json (all retired). Containment is expressed positionally: a tag is legal wherever it's listed as a child (literally or via a macro) of its nearest tracked ancestor. Nothing needs a denylist - if it's not reachable from a node's children, it's invalid there, full stop. The only place position isn't enough is fx-repeat-ref, which needs a literal ancestor *path* (template > fx-repeat) because <template> is a plain HTML tag reused outside Fore too - that's the one entry in 'exceptions'. Per-tag flags beyond attrs/children: 'authorable: false' (fx-repeatitem, fx-repeat-attributes, fx-abstract-control - real tags/classes the linter should still recognize by name, but flag as an error if a user writes them literally, since they're runtime-generated from data-ref attributes or base-class-only); 'requiredChildren' (fx-repeat needs a <template> - absence should warn, not just silently permit-if-present); and 'requiredAttrs' ({all: [...], anyOf: [...], severity: 'error'|'warning'} - grounded in source: 'error' where the element's own code throws/console.errors/dispatches an error event when the attr is missing, 'warning' where it silently no-ops or falls back to a default and is merely pointless without it). Containment between the two runtime-generated repeat classes is one-directional: an fx-repeat-attributes section (data-ref) may contain an fx-repeat, but fx-repeat may never contain fx-repeat-attributes. Attribute lists were cross-checked against each class's observedAttributes/getAttribute reads, not just fore-docs (which itself was missing some of these) - fx-model.undo/undo-depth, fx-fore.keyboard-shortcuts, fx-repeat.size/virtual/focus-on-create, fx-trigger.activate-on-focus/debounce, fx-container.readonly/refresh-on-view, fx-include.selector, fx-control.as/credentials/debounce/initial/listen-on/on-demand/shadow/src/value-prop, and others were found this way. Validated against all 188 files in demo/ (see demo/fore-codemirror/_lint-demos-check.mjs, run once during integration then removed) - containment rules were widened from evidence found there: fx-fore also allows top-level actions/fx-var/nested fx-fore (action-block.html, nested-fore-instance.html), fx-connection/fx-output allow ACTION-ELEMENTS (connection.html, actions.html), fx-bind allows fx-alert (revalidate.html + fore-docs), fx-control allows fx-trigger (markdown-editor.html), fx-switch allows UI-ELEMENTS/ACTION-ELEMENTS alongside fx-case (accordion.html), action elements allow fx-var (duration.html), and fx-items/fx-alert allow static HTML-ELEMENTS content instead of always being ref-bound (radiobuttons.html). requiredAttrs was correspondingly removed from fx-group/fx-switch/fx-alert/fx-items once real demos showed them legitimately used unbound - the 'isBound() soft pattern' evidence only reliably predicts pointlessness for elements whose whole purpose IS the binding (fx-bind, fx-repeat, fx-delete), not general-purpose containers. Attributes shared by many tags are not repeated per tag: 'attrGroups' holds them once (foreElement = ForeElementMixin's ref/context/value; action = AbstractAction's event/if/while/iterate/delay/target/phase/propagate/default-action) and a tag opts in with 'inherits' (action tags list both groups, other ForeElementMixin/UIElement-based tags list foreElement, plain HTMLElement tags like fx-fore/fx-model/fx-instance list none). The full attribute set of a tag is therefore its own 'attrs' + the attrs of every group in 'inherits' + 'htmlGlobalAttrs' (exact names and data-/aria- prefixes). 'template' carries attrs too (draggable/drop-target/drop-scope): fx-repeat reads those from its <template>, not from itself. default-action is the kebab-case spelling; the legacy camelCase defaultAction is still read by the code but deliberately not listed. 'docs' holds a short description of every element and attribute for tooltips; it is generated from the fore-skills element reference by scripts/build-tree-docs.mjs (npm run docs:tree) and is not grammar - nothing validates against it. Per element 'attrs' has the entries that element documents itself; 'shared' covers the attributes of the attrGroups. 'unique' lists children that may occur at most once per parent because the parent only looks up the first one (fx-fore: querySelector('fx-model'); fx-repeat: querySelector('template'); fx-control: querySelector('fx-alert')); an editor should not offer them again once present.

HTML-ELEMENTS.note: any plain (non fx-*) HTML tag. The linter already ignores non fx-* tags, so this macro is documentation only - it doesn't need enumerating or expanding at lint time.

fx-model.note: undo (boolean opt-in, enables the UndoManager) and undo-depth (max history size) - src/fx-model.js:334-336. Companion fx-undo/fx-redo/fx-commit-history actions read getEffectiveUndoManager() but define no attrs of their own.

fx-bind.note: ref defaults to '.' with no warning if absent (src/fx-bind.js:80) - valid but usually not what's intended.

fx-submission.note: logs "id is required" if absent - src/fx-submission.js:25.

fx-header.note: throws in constructor if absent - src/fx-header.js:11.

fx-connection.note: _connect() silently skips creating the WebSocket if empty, no warning - src/fx-connection.js:130-137.

fx-function.note: logs "signature is a required attribute" then throws calling .match() on the null signature - src/functions/registerFunction.js:30.

fx-var.note: unused/unreferenceable without a name, no warning.

fx-group.note: generic isBound() = hasAttribute('ref') soft pattern - unbound just renders/does nothing useful, no warning.

fx-switch.note: generic isBound() soft pattern, same as fx-group.

fx-repeat.note: fx-repeat is meaningless without a <template> child - the linter should warn, not just permit-if-present. Does NOT accept fx-repeat-attributes as a child - that relationship runs the other way (see fx-repeat-attributes). ref has no fallback at all (not even '.') and no throw - nodeset evaluation is silently broken downstream (src/ui/fx-repeat.js:206). size (progressive-rendering row cap) and virtual (windowed virtualization) - src/ui/fx-repeat.js:176,188.

template.note: only carries this child list when it's an immediate child of fx-repeat - see 'exceptions' for how fx-repeat-ref enforces that.

fx-repeat-attributes.note: not written as a literal tag - synthesized at runtime for a plain HTML element carrying a data-ref attribute ('non-visible', like fx-repeatitem). That data-ref section CAN contain an fx-repeat (reachable here via UI-ELEMENTS), but the reverse is disallowed: fx-repeat itself must not contain one.

fx-repeatitem.note: generated by fx-repeat at runtime, one per iteration - never write this by hand, it'll conflict with what fx-repeat itself creates. Its content shape (html/ui/action) is still meaningful for documentation, since that's what ends up inside it.

fx-abstract-control.note: base class inherited by concrete controls (fx-control, fx-output, ...) - not a tag the user ever writes directly.

fx-output.note: refresh() does nothing if neither is set - src/ui/fx-output.js.

fx-trigger.note: ref confirmed genuinely optional (only affects readonly-disable behavior) - not marked required. activate-on-focus fires the action on focus, not just click/Enter/Space - src/ui/fx-trigger.js:43.

fx-setvalue.note: throws "fx-setvalue must specify a 'ref' attribute" - src/actions/fx-setvalue.js:40.

fx-insert.note: not given a blanket requiredAttrs - ref is only required in JSON-lens mode (throws if not a lens path starting with '?', src/actions/fx-insert.js:559-562), template throws on invalid JSON when used (src/actions/fx-insert.js:128), origin just warns+falls back if it doesn't resolve (src/actions/fx-insert.js:453,459). Too mode-dependent to state as one rule.

fx-delete.note: defaults to '.' with no warning - src/actions/fx-delete.js.

fx-send.note: dispatches error "<fx-submission> not found" unless connection is given instead - src/actions/fx-send.js:58-77.

fx-dispatch.note: throws "no event specified for dispatch" - src/actions/fx-dispatch.js:45.

fx-toggle.note: dispatches error "fx-case id not found" if the id doesn't resolve - src/actions/fx-toggle.js perform().

fx-show.note: dispatches error event if absent, plus console.error if the id doesn't resolve - src/actions/fx-show.js:20,37.

fx-hide.note: dispatches error event if absent - src/actions/fx-hide.js:26.

fx-setattribute.note: throws if ref absent - src/actions/fx-setattribute.js:45; dispatches error "name or value not specified" if neither given - line 47.

fx-load.note: _evaluateUrlExpression() throws "url not specified" if absent - src/actions/fx-load.js:200.

fx-setfocus.note: dispatches error "Instance '...' not found" if the target can't be resolved - src/actions/fx-setfocus.js:33-39.

fx-replace.note: evaluateXPathToFirstNode(null, ...) resolves to no target and perform() silently bails - src/actions/fx-replace.js:41-42.

fx-reset.note: dispatches error "instance does not exist" if absent - src/actions/fx-reset.js:25.

fx-append.note: unresolved id causes a raw TypeError accessing repeat.shadowRoot rather than a Fore-level diagnostic - src/actions/fx-append.js _dataFromTemplate.

fx-confirm.note: defaults to null; window.confirm(null) shows the literal text "null" - src/actions/fx-confirm.js.

fx-insertchild.note: if absent, parent is interpolated directly into a generated <fx-insert context="${this.parent}">, becoming the literal string context="null" - silently breaks the insert with no diagnostic - src/actions/fx-insertchild.js:69-73. With child and no origin it does not clone: it creates an empty element named child (literal, or {xpath} templates) as the first/last child (position) of parent, in parent's namespace - see src/actions/fx-insertchild.js. It refuses a parent that is an HTMLTemplateElement (XHTML-namespaced <template>), whose children live in .content.

fx-repeat-ref.reason: template is a generic HTML tag also used outside Fore, so its tree node's child list alone can't guarantee this specific <template> belongs to an <fx-repeat>. This is the only rule of its kind - everything else is captured by position.

shared.ref: XPath binding expression — selects the data node this element is bound to
shared.context: Custom context node for XPath evaluation
shared.value: XPath expression or text content used as the element's value
shared.event: DOM event name to listen for
shared.if: Boolean XPath condition — action only runs if true
shared.iterate: XPath sequence to iterate over; action runs once per item
shared.target: ID of element to attach listener to (special: #window, #document)

fx-fore.description: Root element for every Fore application. Handles lifecycle, update cycle, and messaging.

attrs.src: URL of external Fore page to load
attrs.selector: CSS selector inside loaded src page (default 'fx-fore')
attrs.create-nodes: Auto-create missing data nodes for bound UI elements
attrs.ignore-expressions: Comma-separated node names to exclude from template expression scanning (always includes [pattern])
attrs.merge-partial: Deprecated/inactive — currently hardcoded to false regardless of this attribute
attrs.refresh-on-view: Enables IntersectionObserver-based lazy refresh — only refresh elements currently in viewport. Renamed from the older lazy-refresh
attrs.strict: Strict mode — dispatches error for conditions like a missing referenced instance
attrs.validate-on: Intended to control when validation runs; currently unused in the code path
attrs.version: Version banner template string, e.g. '[VI]Version: {version} - built on {date}[/VI]'
attrs.init-on: Event name to wait for before initializing Fore
attrs.init-on-target: Comma-separated list of targets for init-on: self, closest, document, window, or a CSS selector
attrs.keyboard-shortcuts: Opt-in undo/redo keyboard shortcuts (overrides native text-field undo within the form); listens on document so shortcuts keep working when focus falls back to body
attrs.show-confirmation: Prompts a beforeunload confirmation dialog if the form is dirty
attrs.no-check: Disables post-ready authoring checks (can also be set via ?no-check query param)

fx-model.description: Holds instances, binds, submissions, and custom functions. Drives the recalculate/revalidate cycle.

attrs.undo: Opt-in — enables the UndoManager for this model (src/fx-model.js:334-336)
attrs.undo-depth: Max history size for the undo manager. Companion fx-undo/fx-redo/fx-commit-history actions read getEffectiveUndoManager() but define no attributes of their own

fx-bind.description: Declaratively attaches constraints and computations to data nodes. Creates ModelItem objects.

attrs.ref: XPath selecting the node(s) to bind (default .)
attrs.calculate: XPath expression whose result is assigned to the bound node. Calculated nodes are always readonly
attrs.constraint: Boolean XPath — node is valid only when true
attrs.readonly: Boolean XPath — node is read-only when true
attrs.required: Boolean XPath — node is required when true
attrs.relevant: Boolean XPath — node is visible/active when true (default true())
attrs.type: XML Schema type (e.g. xs:integer, default xs:string)
attrs.initial: XPath expression evaluated once per bound node to assign a one-time value (XForms 2.0 initial), before any calculate runs; overwrites an existing value, failing expressions yield '' (5.1.0)
attrs.alert: Inline validation alert text shown when constraint fails

fx-instance.description: Container for data. The first <fx-instance type="html"> in a model is the default instance.

attrs.id: Instance identifier; used as instance('id') in XPath. The default instance is always the first instance in the model (an id of 'default' is implied if none is given). id="default" on any other instance is an error (reported since 5.2.0)
attrs.src: URL to load instance data from — also accepts #querystring or localStore:<key>
attrs.type: "xml" (default; external src only, no inline content) | "json" | "text" | "html" (use for inline data)
attrs.shared: Marks the instance as reachable from other fx-fore scopes via instance('id')
attrs.static: Asserts that no fx-bind, fx-var or model dependency reads this instance (e.g. a language file only read by controls and templates). Replacing its data then only refreshes the UI and skips the model's rebuild, recalculate and revalidate. Never set it on the default instance or on one that binds depend on.

fx-submission.description: Wraps HTTP requests for submitting or loading data.

attrs.id: Required — used by fx-send to activate this submission
attrs.method: HTTP method: get (default), post, put, delete, head, urlencoded-post, consume
attrs.ref: XPath of the data node/instance to submit (what gets serialized into the request body) — read via instance attribute internally, falls back to model's default instance
attrs.instance: Instance ID whose data is submitted, and (when replace="instance") the instance the response is put into
attrs.replace: What to do with the response: 'all' (replaces the whole page — the default, almost always wrong for API calls), 'instance', 'none', 'download', 'target', 'redirect'. fore-tree.json's own enum only lists "all" | "instance" | "none" — narrower than what the source actually implements; see final report
attrs.into: XPath location in the target instance where the response is inserted
attrs.targetref: XPath to the node in the target instance to be replaced by the response
attrs.target: CSS selector, or '_blank' — used with replace="download"/"target"/"all"
attrs.mediatype: Media type of submitted content (default application/xml)
attrs.responsemediatype: Expected media type of response (defaults to mediatype)
attrs.validate: "true" (default) | "false" — validate before submit. Only the submitted data is validated: the ref subtree, or the root of the default instance without ref (after 5.2.0, unreleased; before that the whole model was validated, so unrelated invalid fields blocked e.g. a DELETE without ref). ref="" behaves like no ref and is flagged by the authoring check

fx-var.description: Declares an in-scope XPath variable. Available in sibling/child XPath expressions as $name.

attrs.name: Required — variable name (referenced in XPath as $name)
attrs.value: XPath expression defining the variable's value

fx-header.description: Adds a custom HTTP header to the enclosing <fx-submission>.

fx-connection.description: Manages a persistent WebSocket connection — sending/receiving messages as JSON, XML, or text, optionally writing incoming data into a bound instance node, with an optional heartbeat ping.

attrs.url: WebSocket endpoint to connect to; reconnects automatically when changed
attrs.heartbeat: Interval in ms to send an empty keep-alive ping; 0 disables heartbeat (default)
attrs.ref: Bound node data is written to/read from (inherited, used heavily here)

fx-control.description: Generic wrapper for interactive controls. Works with any native or third-party widget.

attrs.ref: XPath binding expression
attrs.update-event: DOM event that triggers value sync to model (default 'blur'); special value 'enter'. fore-tree.json only enumerates these two recognized/special values — any other DOM event name (e.g. 'input', 'change') is also accepted, as seen in demos
attrs.debounce: Debounce delay in ms for update-event
attrs.label: Label text (shorthand; alternatively use a <label> child)
attrs.value-prop: DOM property used as the widget value (default 'value'; "selectedOptions" when widget has multiple; use "checked" for checkboxes)
attrs.listen-on: CSS selector for a custom event target within the control
attrs.on-demand: Defer binding until a show-control event is received
attrs.initial: XPath expression evaluated to seed an embedded Fore's initial data when using src
attrs.src: URL to load widget markup from (an embedded Fore page)
attrs.as: "xml" to parse widget value as XML | "node" to bind as node
attrs.shadow: When using src, load the embedded Fore into this control's shadow DOM instead of light DOM

fx-abstract-control.description: Internal base class — not meant to be authored directly in HTML. Provides model-item binding, refresh cycle, and required/readonly/valid/relevant state management shared by all controls (fx-control, fx-output, fx-trigger, fx-upload, fx-hint, fx-alert, fx-control-menu).

attrs.as: When 'node', binds/replaces the whole node instead of a string value

attrs.ref: XPath binding expression for bound output
attrs.mediatype: "html" | "image" to change rendering mode; otherwise rendered as text. With "html" the markup is sanitized against XSS (DOMPurify) since 5.2.0 — scripts, event handlers and javascript: URLs are stripped; a node value is serialized first, so the instance node is no longer moved into the widget
attrs.unsafe: Only with mediatype="html" (5.2.0): skips sanitizing and writes the HTML straight into the DOM. Only use when the content is not user-supplied (XSS risk)
attrs.html: When set, output is treated as a node/XML result rather than a plain string

fx-trigger.description: Wrapper for interactive elements (buttons, links) that execute actions when clicked.

attrs.ref: Optional XPath binding — confirmed genuinely optional (only affects readonly-disable behavior), not required
attrs.activate-on-focus: Fires the action on focus, not just click/Enter/Space (src/ui/fx-trigger.js:43)
attrs.debounce: Debounce delay in ms for click handler

fx-group.description: Groups bound UI elements under a common context node. Handles relevance for the whole group.

attrs.ref: XPath binding — all children inherit this context
attrs.collapse: Marks the group as collapsible (used with CSS)
attrs.on-demand: Defer showing the group until explicitly activated

fx-container.description: Internal base class, extended by fx-case, fx-group, fx-switch. Reacts only to the relevant/nonrelevant facet, not full value/validity handling. Also usable standalone as a plain relevance-reactive container.

attrs.src: Parsed but currently unused — the corresponding load logic is commented out in source
attrs.refresh-on-view: When present, skips refresh unless forced

fx-repeat.description: Repeats its template for each node in the bound nodeset.

attrs.ref: Required — XPath nodeset; one repeat item per node. Has no fallback at all (not even .) and no throw — nodeset evaluation is silently broken downstream if absent (src/ui/fx-repeat.js:206)
attrs.focus-on-create: CSS selector to focus after a new item is inserted
attrs.virtual: Opt-in true windowed virtualization; only meaningful together with a finite size (src/ui/fx-repeat.js:188)
attrs.drop-target: Set on the <template> element (not fx-repeat itself): CSS selector/marker for a drag-and-drop target
attrs.draggable: Set on the <template> element: enables drag reordering of repeat items
attrs.drop-scope: Set on the <template> element: "parent" opts in to real-parentage drag/drop scoping instead of id-string-equality scoping (src/withDraggability.js). Not present in fore-tree.json's attrs list for fx-repeat — found directly in source; flagged for manual review

fx-repeat-ref.description: Placeholder used inside an fx-repeat's <template> to recurse into a node's own matching descendants (XSLT apply-templates style), so arbitrary-depth self-similar data (trees, org charts, threaded comments, nested categories, outline structures) can be rendered with one template instead of a hand-written, depth-capped chain of nested fx-repeats. On connect it replaces itself with a synthesized fx-repeat that reuses the nearest ancestor repeat's ref (or an explicit ref override) and a clone of that ancestor's <template> — including this same placeholder, so recursion continues one level deeper wherever a materialized item's node has matching children. It terminates naturally when a leaf node's synthesized repeat evaluates its ref against zero children.

attrs.ref: Optional override — defaults to the ancestor fx-repeat's own ref if absent

fx-repeat-attributes.description: A variant of fx-repeat for when repeat items must live inside a specific descendant marked [data-ref] (e.g. a native <ul> or <select>) rather than directly under the repeat element itself. Supports drag-and-drop reordering. That data-ref section may itself contain an fx-repeat, but the reverse is disallowed — fx-repeat may never contain an fx-repeat-attributes section.

attrs.ref: Inherited binding — the nodeset to repeat over
attrs.focus-on-create: Selector/marker for which element to focus when a new item is created

fx-repeatitem.description: Internal element — created programmatically by fx-repeat/fx-repeat-attributes to wrap each instantiated row. Not meant to be authored directly; the <template> content inside fx-repeat is automatically wrapped in this element.

attrs.repeat-index: Marks the currently selected item (set by the parent repeat)
attrs.relevant: Reflects the bound modelItem's relevant facet
attrs.nonrelevant: Reflects the bound modelItem's relevant facet

fx-switch.description: Container that shows exactly one <fx-case> at a time.

attrs.ref: Optional binding — activates the fx-case whose name matches the bound value
attrs.appearance: "tabs" opts in to the ARIA tabs pattern (role="tablist"/"tab"/"tabpanel", aria-selected, arrow-key navigation); requires fx-trigger tab controls (each with an fx-toggle targeting a sibling fx-case) as direct children. Not present in fore-tree.json's attrs list for fx-switch — found directly in source (src/ui/fx-switch.js:36); flagged for manual review

fx-case.description: A selectable panel within <fx-switch>. Only the selected case is rendered.

attrs.name: Name matched against bound switch value
attrs.label: Optional label text for the case
attrs.src: URL to lazy-load markup when this case is selected

fx-dialog.description: Modal dialog container. Shown/hidden via fx-show/fx-hide actions.

fx-alert.description: Displays validation error messages. Can be a child of fx-control or fx-bind; also created automatically when a bind declares an alert.

attrs.ref: Optional XPath binding for dynamic alert text

fx-hint.description: Deprecated — use a plain <span> with a template expression instead.

fx-include.description: Lazy light-DOM include component. Loads markup on a configured event.

attrs.target: Event target: "self" (default) | "document" | "window", or a CSS selector
attrs.src: External HTML file URL to load
attrs.selector: CSS selector inside the external HTML
attrs.immediate: Include content immediately on connection (waits for owning fx-fore to be ready)
attrs.reload: Re-include on every matching event (clears previous content)

fx-upload.description: Allows uploading files and embedding their content (base64 or text) into a data instance.

attrs.ref: XPath binding expression
attrs.accept: File type filter (same syntax as HTML <input accept>)
attrs.filename: XPath expression identifying the node to receive the uploaded file's name
attrs.mimetype: XPath expression identifying the node to receive the uploaded file's MIME type
attrs.label: Label text

fx-items.description: Provides a templated list of options. Not standalone — must be used nested within an fx-control's widget slot.

attrs.ref: XPath nodeset for list items
attrs.value: XPath expression for each item's value

fx-droptarget.description: Drag-and-drop target element. Extends ForeElementMixin with a draggability mixin; all behavior comes from that mixin.

fx-control-menu.description: Finds all on-demand elements within a scoped container and offers them in a popup menu (opened via a slotted <button>) so the user can activate/show them individually.

attrs.select: CSS selector identifying the scoped container of on-demand elements (falls back to the enclosing fx-repeatitem if inside a repeat)
attrs.mode: 'hide-on-empty' — auto-marks empty widgets' controls as on-demand once the form is ready

fx-inspector.description: Debugging panel that lists all live fx-instance elements within the closest fx-fore as expandable sections showing serialized instance data, updated on every refresh-done. A developer tool, not a form-authoring element.

attrs.open: Reflected — toggled by clicking the drag handle; expands the panel

fx-speech.description: Voice input component using the Web Speech API. Guides the user field-by-field through bound fx-control elements.

fx-setvalue.description: Sets the value of a bound data node.

attrs.ref: Required — XPath of the node to set
attrs.value: XPath expression for the new value; falls back to text content

fx-insert.description: Inserts data nodes into an instance (XML or JSON).

attrs.ref: XPath of the nodeset to insert relative to
attrs.origin: XPath, JSON-lens ref, or JSON literal used as the template value for the new node
attrs.at: Position index (default: last item in nodeset)
attrs.keep-values: Preserve values from origin node instead of clearing them
attrs.template: ID of a <template> element supplying JSON insert content (JSON mode only)

fx-insertchild.description: Inserts a new child node under an arbitrary parent XPath location — internally builds and delegates to a hidden fx-insert context="${parent}"> in its shadow DOM. Useful for context-relative insertion, e.g. from within a recursive fx-repeat-ref template where there is no single named repeat to target.

attrs.parent: XPath of the parent node to insert into (interpolated into an internal fx-insert context="...")
attrs.child: Name of the child element to create
attrs.origin: XPath/template source for the new node's content
attrs.keep-values: Preserve values from origin node instead of clearing them

fx-delete.description: Removes nodes from a data instance (XML or JSON).

attrs.ref: XPath (XML) or JSON-lens path (JSON) selecting node(s) to delete (default .)

attrs.submission: ID of the fx-submission to activate
attrs.connection: ID of fx-connection to send through instead of a submission

fx-dispatch.description: Dispatches a custom event with optional parameters.

attrs.name: Required — event name to dispatch
attrs.targetid: ID of target element to dispatch on (dispatches on document if omitted)

fx-message.description: Displays a message to the user.

attrs.case: ID of the fx-case to activate

attrs.dialog: Required — ID of the fx-dialog to show/hide

fx-setattribute.description: Creates or sets an attribute on a data node.

attrs.ref: Required — XPath of the target element
attrs.name: Required (with value, anyOf) — attribute name to set
attrs.value: XPath expression for the attribute value (since 5.2.0 — before that it was written as literal text). Quote literals: value="'true'"; empty value="" sets an empty string

fx-load.description: Loads a URL into the window, a new tab, or embeds HTML into the current page.

attrs.await: Event name to wait for after loading

fx-setfocus.description: Sets focus to a target control.

attrs.control: ID of the control to focus
attrs.select: Also select all text in the focused control

attrs.force: Force re-render even if data hasn't changed
attrs.self: Refresh only the closest enclosing control
attrs.selector: CSS selector identifying the element to refresh
attrs.control: ID of a control to refresh

fx-replace.description: Replaces a data node with another.

attrs.ref: XPath of the node to replace

fx-copy.description: Copies the string value of the bound node to the clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText().

attrs.ref: Required — XPath of the node/value to copy
attrs.to: Reserved for a future copy target (currently unused by perform())

fx-toggleboolean.description: Toggles a boolean value at the bound node (switches 'true'↔'false').

attrs.ref: XPath of the boolean data node

fx-call.description: Calls a named action block or XPath function.

attrs.action: ID of the action element to call
attrs.function: Name of the XPath function to call (read from the function HTML attribute)

fx-reset.description: Resets a named data instance back to its inline template/default data.

attrs.instance: ID of the instance to reset

fx-undo.description: Restores the instance data of the model to the state before the last undoable action chain (requires fx-model undo). Guards against rapid double-click re-entering perform() while a prior undo is still applying.

fx-redo.description: Re-applies the most recently undone action chain (requires fx-model undo). Same double-click guard as fx-undo.

fx-commit-history.description: Closes the currently open undo-coalescing session (see UndoManager.commitCoalesced()), so the next edit — even to a field that's still focused — starts a new undo step instead of merging into the current one. Useful for forcing a checkpoint mid-edit, e.g. on Enter in a textarea, without requiring the user to blur the field. Never creates an undo step of its own — it doesn't mutate data, only draws a boundary in the history that's already there.

fx-update.description: Triggers the model update cycle (rebuild → recalculate → revalidate → refresh).

fx-append.description: Deprecated — use <fx-insert> instead. Appends an entry to a repeat.

attrs.ref: XPath of the node template to append
attrs.repeat: ID of the fx-repeat to append to

fx-construct-done.description: Marker action that fires after model construction. Used to initialize data.

fx-unmodified.description: Resets the dirty/modification state of the form.

fx-action.description: Groups multiple actions to execute sequentially, deferring the update cycle until the whole block finishes. Can also load an external script via src.

attrs.src: Path to an external script; if set, runs the script instead of child actions

fx-return.description: Returns from an fx-call invocation — returns the action's current nodeset up to the host Fore, similar to a submission with replace="instance".

fx-confirm.description: Shows a native confirmation dialog before proceeding with nested actions (extends fx-action).

attrs.message: Text shown in the confirm dialog

fx-function.description: Defines a custom XPath function using XPath/XQuery body.

attrs.signature: Required — XPath function signature (name and argument types)
attrs.override: Whether this function overrides an existing one with the same signature (default 'true')

fx-functionlib.description: Loads an external library of custom XPath functions — either a JS module exporting functions/fxFunctions, or an HTML document containing <fx-function> elements.

attrs.src: Required — URL of the function library to load
attrs.prefix: Namespace prefix applied to all registered function signatures from this library
attrs.type: "module" | "html"; auto-detected from src extension if omitted

fx-debugger.description: Read-only debugger shell for a target <fx-fore>: renders overview panels, dependency-graph diagnostics, and a passive event/action-flow log. Explicitly out of scope per its own header comment: no mutation, no editing, no breakpoints. Auto-injected by tools/debug/auto-debugger.js (imported from index.js/index-build.js) when the page URL has a ?debug or ?debug=<fore-id> query parameter — it resolves the target fx-fore (defaulting to the first one on the page, or the one matching the given id), assigns it an id if it lacks one, and inserts one <fx-debugger> at the top of <body>.

attrs.for: Id of the target fx-fore element to attach to
attrs.gate-init: When present, delays the target fx-fore's initialization until the debugger is ready (sets init-on/init-on-target on the target so it waits for a fx-debugger-ready-<id> event) — set automatically by the ?debug auto-injector

fx-lens.description: Dependency-less instance viewer: a resizable, light-DOM side panel showing a collapsible tree view of XML/HTML/JSON/text fx-instance data, with per-instance open/closed state persisted to localStorage (lens-panels-keys) and panel open/width persisted under lens-open/related keys. Imported directly by demo/demo.js (so it's live across the whole curated demo suite) and by many individual demo pages. Also self-attaches: if the page URL has ?lens or ?inspect (kept for compatibility) and no <fx-lens> exists yet, one is appended automatically.

attrs.open: Reflects/controls whether the panel is expanded; toggled by clicking its .handle, and persisted across reloads

template.description: The row template of an fx-repeat. Beside the markup it carries the repeat's drag and drop settings.

attrs.draggable: "true" makes the repeat items draggable, so they can be reordered by drag and drop.
attrs.drop-target: Id of the repeat that items may be dropped into. Items can only move between repeats that share this id.
attrs.drop-scope: "parent" restricts drops to items with the same parent node in the data, instead of comparing repeat ids. Needed for recursive trees (fx-repeat-ref).

attrs.dialog: Id of the dialog to close.
